scripts.repo:guard: uv run --all-packages python -m unittest tests.test_docs_structure tests.test_workspace_layout tests.test_repo_collaboration tests.test_package_script_policy tests.ingestion.test_ingestion_task_executability tests.api.test_app_api_collector_execution_boundary -q
scripts.ci:repo: pnpm repo:guard && uv run --all-packages python -m scripts.check_repo_static --affected --base "${CI_BASE_REF:-origin/main}"
scripts.ci:contracts: pnpm contracts:check && uv run --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s tests/contracts -t . -q
scripts.ci:ingest: uv run --all-packages python -m unittest discover -s tests/ingestion -t . -q
scripts.ci:eval: pnpm --dir packages/eval-langfuse typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/eval-langfuse test && pnpm --dir apps/app-api exec tsx ./scripts/check-langfuse-trace-id-vectors.ts
scripts.ci:worker: pnpm web:test:worker && pnpm --dir apps/app-api exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/campus-agent-app-api-worker-bundle --env local && pnpm --dir apps/campus-web build:app && pnpm --dir apps/operator-console-web build
scripts.ci:config: pnpm ci:actions:lint && uvx zizmor --min-severity=medium .github && uv run --all-packages python -m scripts.check_workflow_action_policy
scripts.ci:deps: go run github.com/google/osv-scanner/v2/cmd/osv-scanner@v2.3.8 scan source --config osv-scanner.toml --format=vertical --verbosity=error --lockfile pnpm-lock.yaml --lockfile uv.lock
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --all-packages python -m scripts.check_contract_schemas && uv run --all-packages python -m scripts.generate_tool_execution_contracts --check
scripts.go:check: test -z "$(gofmt -l apps/execution-control)" && cd apps/execution-control && go vet ./... && export PATH="$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH" && if ! command -v golangci-lint >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'golangci-lint v2.11.4 is required. Install it from https://golangci-lint.run/welcome/install/'; exit 1; fi && golangci-lint run ./... && go test ./...
